newsitem.title: UK: London tea auction sees gains for good liquorers.
newsitem.headline: London tea auction sees gains for good liquorers.

text.p: Tea prices were generally steady at Monday's London auction although selected medium and better quality types managed gains of up to four pence per kg, the official report said.
In the landed sector, solid demand brought increases of two to three pence per kg for coloury medium East Africans while bright liquoring teas achieved firm to fractionally higher rates.
A mostly Kenyan offshore offering of 1,400 packages found good enquiry at firm prices, the report said.
The next auction is on Monday, February 24. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8071
